out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. UPON ARRIVAL, EHS CONFIRMED NO CFM WAS PRESENT DURING ACTIVE FOOD PREPARATION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. DURING THE INSPECTION, A CFM ARRIVED. EHS AND CFM DISCUSSED THE REQUIREMENT FOR A CFM TO BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS WHICH THE FACILITY IS OPERATING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. EHS NOTED 2 OUT OF THREE HANDSINKS IN THE KITCHEN WERE NOT SUPPLIED WITH PAPER TOWELS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. DURING THE INSPECTION, HANDSINKS WERE ADEQUATELY STOCKED WITH PAPER TOWELS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: CREAMED KALE MARKED 9/11, AIOLI MARKED 9/1, TARRAGON AIOLI , TYME CREAM CHEESE MARKED 9/1.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM COMPLIED WITH THE EHS’S REQUEST TO DISCARD FOOD. TRUMMER'S ON MAIN (Inspection Date: 09/18/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: EHS NOTED MENU ITEM “ADD EGG” ON THE PRINTED MENU WAS NOT INDICATED IN SUCH A WAY AS TO ALERT THE CUSTOMER THAT THE PRODUCT MAY BE SERVED UNDERCOOKED.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS REQUESTS THE FACILITY INCLUDE A DISCLOSURE ON ALL ANIMAL PROTEINS THAT MAY BE SERVED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: EHS OBSERVED A TOOTH BRUSH AND TOOTH PASTE IN A PLASTIC BAG STORED ON A SHELF IN THE PASTRY PREP AREA ALONGSIDE PASTRY SUPPLIES
violations.corrective_action: CFM COMPLIED WITH THE EHS’S REQUEST TO REMOVE PERSONAL CARE ITEMS FROM THE KITCHEN AND STORE THEM IN DESIGNATED AREAS.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: EHS OBSERVED RAW SHRIMP THAWING IN STANDING WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. KITCHEN STAFF MEMBER COMPLIED WITH THE EHS’S REQUEST TO THAW THE RAW SHRIMP UNDER COLD, RUNNING WATER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Galvanized Metal Not Used with Acidic Food
violations.observation: EHS NOTED COPPER MUGS IN THE BAR AREA POTENTIALLY WERE NOT ADEQUATELY LINED TO PREVENT LEACHING. KITCHEN STAFF MEMBER COULD NOT CONFIRM THE MUGS WERE LINED.
violations.corrective_action: KITCHEN STAFF MEMBER AGREED TO DISCARD THE COPPER MUGS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: EHS NOTED THE BAR CHEMICAL SANITIZING DISH MACHINE IS NOT MEETING THE DATA PLATE REQUIREMENTS. CHLORINE CONCENTRATION LESS THAN 50PPM AND HOT WATER DURING WASH CYCLE WAS 103F (DATA PLATE REQUIRES 120F). EHS NOTED THE HIGH TEMPERATURE SANITIZING DISH MACHINE IS NOT MEETING REQUIREMENTS FOR SANITIZING. IRREVERSIBLE THERMOMETER REGISTERED 124F MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: FACILITY MUST DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE CHEMICAL AND HIGH TEMPERATURE SANITIZING DISH MACHINE UNTIL THEY CAN BE SERVICED AND COMPLIANT WITH DATA PLATE SPECIFICATIONS. ALL TABLEWARE, KITCHENWARE, AND UTENSILS MUST BE SANITIZED IN THE TRIPLE SINK.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: EHS NOTED THE FACILITY IS UTILIZING PLASTIC MILK CRATES FOR THE STORAGE OF CLEAN TABLEWARE., A CINDER BLOCK WAS BEING USED TO ELEVATE A PREP TABLE, UNFINISHED WOOD WAS BEING USED UNDER A STORAGE SHELF, AND UNFINISHED WOOD WAS BEING USED AS A SHELF TO STORE CUTTING BOARDS.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS REQUESTS THE FACILITY DISCONTINUE THE USE OF MILK CRATES, CINDER BLOCKS, AND UNFINISHED WOOD IN THE FOOD PREP AND STORAGE AREAS AND DISH ROOM.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS NOTED WASTEWATER PIPING LEAKING UNDER THE HANDSINK TO THE LEFT OF THE COOK LINE AND UNDER THE PREP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS REQUESTS THE FACILITY REPAIR WASTEWATER PIPING UNDER THE AFOREMENTIONED SINKS.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed no 2026 health permit posted in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. CFM/owner posted 2026 health permit in conspicuous location at bar.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. No soap provided at hand sink in dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM provided soap for hand sink.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The high temperature dish machine was observed at a maximum temperature of 150F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the dishmachine so that an irreversible thermometer will read 160F after cycling through. Until the machine is adequately repaired, the dish machine can be used to wash and rinse dishware and 3 compartment sink used to chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed the bar dish machine at a chlorine concentration below 50ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All bar dishware must be washed, rinsed in the upstairs kitchen dish machine and sanitized in the 3 compartment sink using quaternary ammonia at a concentration between 200-400ppm.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: short rib au jus observed on prep table at 76F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM reheated short rib au just and hot held at 152F.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: lobster bisque at 56F, potato salad at 56F, veal at 55F in #6; cheesecake at 54F in #2.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded all food from unit #6. Cheesecake moved to #10 (WIC).

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Hot water sanitizing dish machine observed at 155F.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter on mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CFM removed unapproved splitter. EHS will provide approved backflow prevention device product information in case CFM requires splitter on mop faucet.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: in the walk-in cooler goulash dated 3/12.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. DISCARDED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: multiple food items in the refrigerated units on the main cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.
